text: Hello, fine, thanks! My name is Billy. How are you today?

speaker: A1MCFLAQ4MOVBZ
text: I am Elvir! Im doing great today, thanks for asking! Do you know about any NPOs? (Non-profit)

speaker: A1NCWY01WAAP2K
text: Nice to meet you, Elvir. I am familiar with NPOs 0 i even volunteer for one. How about you?

speaker: A1MCFLAQ4MOVBZ
text: I am a frequent donator to NPOs. What is the NPO that you volunteer for?

speaker: A1NCWY01WAAP2K
text: That is nice to hear. From time to time I volunteer for a tiny NPO school that teaches economics and social science to adults.

speaker: A1MCFLAQ4MOVBZ
text: Oh nice! Is it local in your area?

speaker: A1NCWY01WAAP2K
text: Yes, although there are several similar schools around the US and across the world. What type of organizations do you support, Elvir?

speaker: A1MCFLAQ4MOVBZ
text: I support NPOs that engage in promoting childrens rights, providing relief and helping support children in developing countries. One NPO mainly being Save the Children.

speaker: A1NCWY01WAAP2K
text: That is wonderful. I am slightly familiar with Save the Children. Do you think that they are effective?

speaker: A1MCFLAQ4MOVBZ
text: They are very effective at their mission, making an international impact with professional and cautious use of the donation they receive. They are one of few NPO's who actually use their funds for their purpose.

speaker: A1NCWY01WAAP2K
text: Yes, mis-use and waste is a huge problem in with NPOs. For this reason I like and support Smile Train - they repair cleft lips using local resources.

speaker: A1MCFLAQ4MOVBZ
text: Thats awesome! The amazing thing about the Save the Children mission is that 77 cents only can host a child in need for shelter for one day!

speaker: A1NCWY01WAAP2K
text: That is very cheap. Good nutrition, medical care, and a clean and safe environment are vital for all, especially children.

speaker: A1MCFLAQ4MOVBZ
text: You will be recieving $2 for the survey completion, would you like to donate any of your compensation to Save The Children organization? It will go a long way for the children!

speaker: A1NCWY01WAAP2K
text: Yes, I would like to help out. There are many more needy than me. I'll give $1.50 to Save the Children.

speaker: A1MCFLAQ4MOVBZ
text: Awesome! Thank you so much for your donation! At the end of the survey it will give you an option to donate that amount. This was a good talk!

speaker: A1NCWY01WAAP2K
text: Yes, I learned from you. I will do some research on Save the Children and consider supporting them.

speaker: A1MCFLAQ4MOVBZ
text: Yes please do! I am a frequent donator of Save the Children! It was my pleasure, have a good day!

speaker: A1NCWY01WAAP2K
text: You too, Elvir. Have a great weekend and thanks again for the information on Save the Children.
